notes.title: Devblog 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the game has been updated!
Now the game's development will continue outside of early access.
This update is more focused on optimization and loot balance.

Changelog 1.0:
[list]
[*] Improved optimization (on average, an increase of 15-20 fps)
[*] Loot balance
[*] Fixed a bug where in multiplayer the helicopter was not visible for clients
[*] Added 3 new zombie skins
[*] More sounds added
[*] Changed respawn points (now you will appear more often near the city)
[*] Fixed collisions in some places
[*] Fixed the issue with not receiving achievements
[*] Added more loot boxes to the map
[*] Removed punching and plant picking skills, now available by default
[*] Increased brightness during night and daytime
[*] Reduced helicopter damage
[*] Other minor changes and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Devblog #5
notes.content:
Hello friends, the game has been updated!

[h3]Changelog 0.0.5:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements added
[*] Added sounds for taking damage
[*] Added new zombie features (zombie with bomb, zombie with helmet, zombie with big hands, zombie without legs or arms, zombie with radiation)
[*] Some weapons have a visual indication of durability (model changes)
[*] Procedural recoil when fired
[*] Ejected shell casings when firing a weapon
[*] When leaving the game or committing suicide, confirmation will be required to avoid accidental pressing
[*] Changed torch and flashlight animations
[*] Added radial menu for quick slots (more useful for controllers)
[*] Added gamma settings
[*] Added the ability to reset control settings
[*] Jumping requires energy
[*] Reduced movement speed when aiming
[*] Improved character movement animations
[*] The grass reacts to the character
[*] Added sight x2 and x4
[*] Big bug fixed
[*] Fixed some interface bugs
[*] Improved performance
[/list]

notes.title: Devblog #4
notes.content:
Hi all! Happy New Year!

A new update has been released for the game

[h3]Contents of the update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Parkour system
[*] electricity system
[*] New loot objects
[*] Added more sound
[*] AI fix and improvement
[*] Added change of mouse sensitivity in aim
[*] Added female character
[*] More clothes added
[*] Added an enemy helicopter that will periodically attack you
[*] Added new temperature and radiation system (Temperature can now be affected by weather, time of day, biome and more)
[*] Random events added
[*] Added night zombie horde (spawns at night and attacks you)
[*] Change in death screen
[*] Added autumn biome
[*] The character is shifted to the left for a better view.
[/list]

Stay tuned for news about the game, beta testing will begin soon
I will be glad to receive feedback and suggestions for the game, which you can leave on the Steam forum or in the [url=https://discord.gg/8Vjvx7pE]Discord channel[/url].

notes.title: Devblog #3 | Release Soon
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

First of all, I want to thank you for your interest in the game.
A new update has been released for the game, which you can try in the demo version of the game

Included in the update:
[list]
[*] Swimming system
[*] Change in weapon recoil
[*] New weapon - grenade launcher
[*] Photo mode
[*] Some changes in driving
[*] More new items
[*] More new animation
[*] Changing and adding sounds
[*] The weapon description displays the required type of ammo
[/list]

New screenshots
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961732/0572253009b4882fabf287d45b6a5f00ffe408ef.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961732/2fd8be0b619962453d50d7cc577e90a4e9c24727.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961732/94b399de2200751fa5bf4f47e46efbb638f70b54.jpg[/img]

I will be glad to receive feedback and suggestions for the game, which you can leave on the Steam forum or in the [url=https://discord.gg/8Vjvx7pE]Discord channel[/url].
Game release is planned for February 2025, stay tuned, the exact date will be announced soon!
